title: Preparation
intro: Click a point in the sky or search by coordinates.

size.label: Cutout size (arcminutes)
size.help: How much sky each side of the image covers. Changes apply immediately to both sky clicks and RA/Dec searches. A larger value usually produces an array with more pixels.

ra.label: Right ascension, RA (°)
ra.help: The point's east/west position in the sky, in the ICRS system. Enter decimal degrees from 0 to less than 360, not hours; for example, 83.63.

dec.label: Declination, Dec (°)
dec.help: The position north or south of the celestial equator, in the ICRS system. Enter decimal degrees between −90 and 90; for example, −5.39. This is not your latitude on Earth.

validation.size: Enter a size between 0.1 and 30 arcminutes in Preparation.
validation.coordinates: Enter RA and Dec in decimal degrees.
validation.ra: Right ascension (RA) must be from 0° to less than 360°.

projectionRequired: To place this image in the sky, set latitude and longitude in Location.

results.empty: There are no observations in this region.
results.choose: Select the observation to load its image.
results.limit: Showing only the most recent observation. Change the detector to see another band.

notices.searchFailed: Could not search for observations in IRSA.

foundMore.one: More than {{count}} image found in IRSA
foundMore.other: More than {{count}} images found in IRSA
